newsitem.title: POLAND: Readymix AG plans major Polish investment -CEO.
newsitem.headline: Readymix AG plans major Polish investment -CEO.

text.p: Building materials producer Readymix AG, German unit of Britain's RMC Group Plc, aims to invest 350-400 million marks in Poland in the next five years, the British embassy in Warsaw said in a statement.

"Readymix AG wants to invest between 350-400 million marks in Poland in the next five years and employ up to 3,000 workers," it quoted Readymix AG fuer Beteiligungen (RMA) Chief Executive Juergen Himstedt as telling an embassy reception.
"We want to focus our group onto the demands of the Polish construction industry on all levels," the statement said. @

He said the firm had so far invested about 40 million marks in Poland. There were joint ventures for ready mixed concrete operations in Lodz and the Gorzow/Slubice region, a cement works in Szczecin, a lime works in Bukowa and an aercrete plant in Ostroleka. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
